label: Research pool deep dive C (24 Oct 2026)

payload.writeUp: Deep dive C of 24 October 2026: a fresh look at 20 UK companies already in the pool, re-checking from their own sites, Companies House, platform listings and the press whether each is genuinely raising now, closed, or unknown. Access status found: 7 closed, 2 contactable, 2 expected, 3 fundraising reported, 6 unknown, 1 verified open. Closed raises are kept so the watch list and timeline stay honest; nothing here is presented as open without a source. Fortis Medical was found to be an Irish company (Galway) and is left out of this UK-only batch.

CSO Prof Carrie Ambler (Durham) is a director; the news page records a £1.5m raise (Jun 2024), Innovate UK Biomedical Catalyst and 2025 grants, NATO DIANA 2026 selection and a Medilink award (May 2026). Companies House shows SH01s on 25 Apr 2025, 7 Oct 2025, 5 Mar 2026 and 30 Sep 2026 — the last lifting nominal capital from £4,300.7 to £5,412.4, the largest step — with new Articles 12 Oct 2026, while directors Coles and Valentine resigned Jul 2026 and CEO Sam Whitehouse resigned as director 30 Sep 2026 (Naseeb Singh appointed May 2024). This pattern suggests a 2026 financing with board change, but no public announcement, valuation, open round or EIS statement was found.
